kpis.name: tNPS / NPS
kpis.definition: Loyalty on a 0-10 recommend question. Promoters 9-10, Passives 7-8, Detractors 0-6.

kpis.name: CSAT
kpis.definition: Satisfaction with an interaction on a 1-5 or 1-10 scale.
kpis.formula: Top-box % = responses in top ratings / total responses * 100; or average score

kpis.name: CES
kpis.definition: How much effort the customer spent to resolve the issue (lower is better).
kpis.formula: Average effort rating; derived from VOC mentions of repeat calls / branch visits

kpis.name: FCR (proxy)
kpis.formula: FCR = (is_repeat_caller == False) AND (Customer Compensated from CC? == 'Yes within the call')

kpis.name: Detractor
kpis.definition: Survey respondent scoring 0-6 on the NPS question.

kpis.name: Contact Rate
kpis.definition: Share of detractors who appear in the Micro (call) dataset.
kpis.formula: Contact Rate = detractors in Micro / total detractors

kpis.name: Reach Rate
kpis.definition: Share of contacted customers actually reached (call happened).
kpis.formula: Reach Rate = rows where call0-1 == 1 / appropriate base

kpis.name: Win-back Rate
kpis.definition: Customers who came back after a retention attempt.
kpis.formula: Win-back = customers returned / total retention attempts

kpis.name: Retention Rate
kpis.formula: Retention = customers stayed / total at-risk customers

kpis.name: Severity Score
kpis.definition: Sum of weighted linguistic risk signals in the VOC.
kpis.formula: Buckets: None 0, Low 1-3, Medium 4-8, High 9-15, Critical 16+

kpis.name: Churn signal
kpis.definition: Customer leaving for a competitor; flagged by churn language in VOC.
kpis.formula: Churn rate = customers lost in period / customers at start of period

kpis.name: QA Auto-Score
kpis.definition: Agent interaction quality, 0-100 from 5 dimensions of 20 each.
